method.sample: rAF intervals overlapping the first 300ms after each actual batch start
method.fps: 1000 / mean sampled rAF interval; not a presented-frame/GPU FPS counter
method.willChange: Property-specific hints, configured before warmup; not promotion guarantees

method.trace: Primary trials run without DevTools tracing, screenshots, or video recording. CDP Performance counters sampled at trial boundaries.
